title: OB_marker glTF node extension
description: meshes.md 3.5: one record of a solid's marker chunk 0x13401A; the matrix is the node's own matrix. The extension's version is in the glTF root object: #/$defs/root.

root.description: meshes.md 3.1: the extension's entry in the glTF root object's extensions, once per file: the lowest version of the extension that reads the file (versioning.md 1, 2.1).
